captchaconsent-desc: Keeps third-party CAPTCHA scripts inactive until the visitor accepts a CookieConsent category
captchaconsent-notice: This form needs the "$1" cookie category for bot protection. It is not accepted, so the CAPTCHA is not loaded and the form cannot be submitted.
captchaconsent-ve-notice: Saving needs a CAPTCHA, and it needs the "$1" cookie category for bot protection. It is not accepted, so the CAPTCHA is not loaded.
